data.rationale: The proposal captures the same overall procedure (arXiv advanced search, Semantic Scholar citation lookup, note) in the right order. It omits the subject category as a parameter and step, wrongly says the first author comes from Semantic Scholar rather than arXiv, and skips opening a new tab and closing it afterward. Without the category parameter the search can't be reproduced, so an automation built from this spec would be incomplete.
